subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should #87711 remain the broad Telegram reset/delivery tracker, or should maintainers split it into narrower canonical issues before implementation?
rationale: Current source shows real remaining work, but the report now combines fixed subcases, related open trackers, and new UX/diagnostic surfaces that need maintainer scoping.

options.title: Keep and split
options.body: Keep #87711 open as the umbrella while opening or assigning narrow reset-durability, delivery-diagnostic, and warm-reset UX work items.

options.title: Narrow in place
options.body: Retitle and scope #87711 to the reset write-order and phantom-binding self-heal invariant, moving heartbeat and warm-reset UX elsewhere.

options.title: Close after reassignment
options.body: Close #87711 only after every remaining ask is explicitly covered by safer canonical issues such as #86592 or #87327.

recommendation.title: Keep and split
recommendation.body: Keep #87711 open as the umbrella while opening or assigning narrow reset-durability, delivery-diagnostic, and warm-reset UX work items.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans channel architecture, session lifecycle, and product scoping rather than one narrow file owner.
